plan.notes: The Orchard Keeper's Daughter is not in Qloo (the search returned only similar-sounding titles), so the plan uses Where the Crawdads Sing and The Last Thing He Told Me as signals for books, podcasts, TV, movies and brands. It uses Delia Owens and Laura Dave as signals for authors and regions. None of the results are sample data. Every book comp has popularity of 0.99 or higher, so treat them as positioning and keep title bids small; put most of the budget on the low-popularity authors (Morton, Kline, Landvik, Benjamin, Mayes). The podcast, TV and movie results lean heavily toward true crime and documentaries, so test them cheaply. No Vermont places came back from Qloo; the region results cluster in Massachusetts and Maine.
